title: The Linux Kernel Organization now lets developers submit AI-generated code, as long as it complies with the guidelines, licensing, and attribution requirements (Simon Batt/XDA Developers)
summary: Simon Batt / XDA Developers: The Linux Kernel Organization now lets developers submit AI-generated code, as long as it complies with the guidelines, licensing, and attribution requirements — - Linux allows AI-generated kernel code, but the community will treat it as your own contribution.
